prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is visible, approach it. Take it if close, check weight and shape. Finally, perform specific task. If obstacle detected, move around it. list of available nodes: <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectClose    /> <Condition ID = CheckObjectWeight    /> <Condition ID = CheckObjectShape    /> <Action ID = MoveForward    /> <Condition ID = ObstacleDetected    /> <Action ID = TurnAround    /> <Action ID = ScanArea    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectVisible? THEN
			DO ApproachObject
	ELSE
			IF IsObjectClose? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
			IF CheckObjectShape? THEN
			DO SpecificTask
	END
